summary: The ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT geography function returns a point at a specified fraction along a linestring.
extended_definition: The ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT geography function returns a point at a specified fraction along a linestring.

supporting_pages.title: Geography functions | BigQuery | Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: WITH fractions AS ( SELECT 0 AS fraction UNION ALL SELECT 0.5 UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL ) SELECT fraction , ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT ( ST_GEOGFROMTEXT ( 'LINESTRING(1 1, 5 5)' ), fraction ) AS point FROM fractions /*-------------+-------------------------------------------+ | fraction | point | +-------------+-------------------------------------------+ | 0 | POINT(1 1) | | 0.5 | POINT(2.99633827268976 3.00182528336078) | | 1 | POINT(5 5) | | NULL | NULL | +-------------+-------------------------------------------*/ ST_LINELOCATEPOINT ST_LINELOCATEPOINT ( linestring_geography , point_geography ) Description Gets a section of a linestring between the start point and a selected point (a point on the linestring closest to the point_geography argument).
Return type FLOAT64 ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT ( linestring_geography , fraction ) Description Gets a point at a specific fraction in a linestring GEOGRAPHY value.
ST_LINEINTERPOLATEPOINT Gets a point at a specific fraction in a linestring GEOGRAPHY value.
